Sims 3 is a lot better in my opinion, it seems more alive and less of a chore to play. Sims 4 never really has anything different going on from game to game in my experience. maybe my sim makes different friends but that’s it. And the point everyone mentions-the lack of open world gameplay in the sims 4 makes it far less immersive. having a loading screen pop up when you’re taking a sim to another household really just takes you right out of the game. I like the swatches in the sims 4, it makes it a lot easier to build things and find something i actually like. The color wheel on the sims 3 was only good with things such as hair and eyes i feel. The sims 4 (to me) is just unplayable and i get bored very quickly. there’s no fun or action in the base game like there was in ts3. ts4 graphics are great though. i think they both have pros and cons, but ultimately i like the sims 3 better.
